unresolved.note: m3mindia.com gives no marketed possession date. The retail listing (m3mindia.com/retail-projects) marks Paragon57 as 'Delivered' while the project page lists it under Ongoing; only the RERA completion date (31-08-2026) is available, which matches our 2026-08.

Builder states '4 levels of retail' plus duplex apartments; the RERA filing's floor plans run from a basement up to a 13th floor. Neither supports our 6 floors, but no single builder floor count was found.
